## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Aug 7, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _narwhalez123_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "Was a big fan of this app a couple of years ago, i find the organisation so satisfying. I re-downloaded it recently and the lag and ai-centric design has really made it into one of the worst note taking apps i have ever used! You can’t do anything without the screen freezing and it feels like it’s just turned into a generic ai chatbot app with a little bit of organisation on the side (that doesn’t even work most of the time??) it’s so disappointing to see and I hope the creators import an ai-free version for notetakers who actually think for themselves, perhaps the lack of ai will make some of the other features less laggy."
            2. _Clashofvlansbrah_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "This app refreshes every 5 seconds while you’re trying to type. Notion for desktop is great. This IOS platform is, and has been broken for a long time."
            3. _alitur43_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I tried this app a couple of years ago as I loved it on my laptop, and I decided to try it again because I assumed that by now they should have fixed the iPad/iPhone functionality up a bit. I was wrong. I actually don't understand how you can have such an appalling usability as an app but be so good on the web, and continue to stay unusable as an app for years at a time despite all the reviews telling you how bad your app is. I can't access templates (FREE templates) on my iPad, it takes me 30 seconds to open old notes, the dashboard and sidebar glitch around once a minute, I struggle to load things up, it drains my battery stupidly quickly and don't even get me STARTED on trying to type things/use the keyboard. Seriously, why is it so hard to do literally anything on the app? The degree to which things STILL don't work after 2 years is surreal to me."
<!--/ir-theme-->
